description:
List time entries between two dates (from and to are YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive). Scope with project (a Time Tracker project id from list_time_tracker_projects) or user (a user id), not both; with neither you get your own entries. Each entry has date, person, project, budget, service, task, exact minutes, hours (e.g. "0.1" = 6 min) and note. A plain member only sees their own time; managers see everyone. Only @seoalive.com accounts can use the time tracking tools.

Cost: 1 credit per call.

Examples:
```json
// list my own entries for November 2026.
{"property":"sc-domain:example.com","from":"2026-11-01","to":"2026-11-30"}
```
name: list_time_entries

render_with.description: Render tool that can display this payload.

title: Time entries
